steps: Rule: TR of next figure = TL of previous (2->2, 5->5, 4->4); BL of next = BR of previous (0->0, 1->1, 2->2).
So ? must have TR = 6 (F4 TL) and BL = 5 (F4 BR).
A: TR 5, BL 4 - fails. C: TR 7, BL 6 - fails. D: TR 4, BL 7 - fails.
B: TL 7, TR 6, BL 5, BR 4 - fits.

answer_value: reversed text reading qfm4eqJ mirrored, upright
steps: Mirror MN is vertical on the right: order reverses and each character flips left-right but stays upright.
B: m and f appear upside down (turned) - fails.
C: whole string is flipped top-to-bottom (water image) - fails.
D: characters mixed, some turned, spacing/letters wrong - fails.
A: every character reversed left-right and upright - correct.

answer_value: arrow from upper-left down to lower-right, head at lower-right
steps: Arrow lies in the upper half, tail near middle line at left, head at top-right.
Folding upper half down reflects it about the middle line: tail stays at left near the fold, head goes to bottom-right.
A: head at left - fails. C: rising arrow (unreflected) - fails. D: head at bottom-left - fails.
B: falling arrow with head at bottom-right - fits.

answer_value: rhombus with vertical, horizontal and both diagonal lines; circle at bottom-right
steps: Circle moves 45 degrees clockwise each step: top-left, top, top-right, right, so next is bottom-right.
Lines inside rhombus increase one at a time: none, vertical, +horizontal, +one diagonal, so next has all four.
All options have 4 lines; A circle bottom-left, B circle top-left, D circle bottom - fail.
C: circle bottom-right - fits.

answer_value: four C-shaped cuts: left column opening left, right column opening right
steps: Folded top onto bottom, then left onto right; cut is a C opening right in the bottom-right quarter.
Unfolding the vertical fold mirrors it to the left column as a reversed C (opening left); unfolding horizontal fold copies both to the top row.
A: left column opens right, right column opens left - reversed, fails.
B: top-right opens right but bottom-right opens left - fails. C: three of four open right - fails.
D: left column opens left, right column opens right in both rows - fits.
